protocol_name: V2-I1 unified entity belief graph post-review correction

amendment_record.reason: Three independent post-development sub-agent reviews found that the apparent V3 pass could not authorize holdout. Position-only hypothesis dedup collapsed distinct identity histories; self softmax discarded sub-threshold competitors; the static front end swallowed paused established entities; occupancy added co-located existence probabilities; active-state and MAC accounting were too low; identity consistency omitted misses and duplicate assignments; the prerequisite artifact was not hash-pinned; and development/validation plus one-shot authorization were not isolated. V4 freezes all corrections before running them. The original holdout remains untouched. Previously exposed 30000-30015 seeds become repeatable calibration only; fresh 32000-32007 seeds are assigned as one-shot validation. The original 0.90 identity intent is preserved and strengthened with visible identity coverage >=0.90; no existing threshold is lowered.

authorization_rules.prerequisite: Require the exact frozen SHA-256 of the tracked V2 stage authorization artifact before every split.
authorization_rules.calibration_to_validation: Strictly validate schema, experiment, split, V4 protocol digest, exact calibration seeds, decision, every gate, provenance, source digest, and clean reviewed commit.
authorization_rules.validation_to_holdout: Apply the same strict validation to the one-shot validation artifact and require the identical reviewed git commit.
authorization_rules.one_shot_reservation: Before the first episode, atomically push a new annotated consumption tag to the shared origin remote, then write the local reservation. A concurrent second push is rejected. An interrupted run consumes the remote tag and requires a new protocol amendment rather than deletion and rerun.
authorization_rules.immutable_result_evidence: A passing validation or completed holdout result is stored as a Git blob and published through a new annotated remote tag. The next stage reads the remote blob, verifies its certificate and SHA-256, and independently recomputes all gates.
